title: Start a world from an existing game definition
setup: Boot from your existing definition and start its saved world offline. [Move an existing project to code-first actions](/migration#keep-a-saved-game-definition)

title: Choose the match for an external debug panel
setup: Select the live match when both a preview and a match own game scopes. Clear the selection to return to automatic lookup. [Set up the debug panel](/game-services#select-a-game-from-a-debug-panel)
